examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjeṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ
nīlā pītā ca kāḷā ca, mañjeṭṭhā atha lohitā, ucc'āvacānaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ, kiñjakkhaparivāritā.
tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjeṭṭhakāya durattavaṇṇam'ev'assa aparisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.

seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, jacc'andho puriso, so na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni, na passeyya mañjeṭṭhikāni rūpāni, na passeyya samavisamaṃ, na passeyya tārakarūpāni, na passeyya candimasūriye.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjeṭṭhiyā vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ
chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso chaphass'āyatano aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.

50806.commentary: (SNa) maññatan'ti maññanaṃ. tividham'pi taṇhā-diṭṭhi-māna-maññanaṃ so vītivatto, atikkanto'ti attho.

examples.text: pahīnamānassa na santi ganthā, vidhūpitā mānaganth'assa sabbe, sa vītivatto maññataṃ sumedho, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyya, loke samaññaṃ kusalo viditvā vohāramattena so vohareyyā'ti.
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ'ca sotabbaṃ maññissanti
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rāhula, cakkhu niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā'ti? aniccaṃ, bhante.
yo bālo maññati bālyaṃ, paṇḍito vā'pi tena so, bālo ca paṇḍitamānī, sa ve bālo'ti vuccati.

50809.meaning1: considers (to be); takes as; regards as; views as; deems as

examples.text: yo ca sītañ'ca uṇhañ'ca, tiṇā bhiyyo na maññati, karaṃ purisakiccāni, so sukhā na vihāyati.
tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.

50810.grammar: pr, reflx 3rd sg of maññati, trans (+acc)
50810.meaning1: one considers oneself; one imagines oneself

examples.text: upekkhako sadā sato, na loke maññate samaṃ, na visesī na nīceyyo, tassa no santi ussadā.
kattari ca attanopadāni honti. maññate, rocate, socate, bujjhate, jāyate.
siṅgālā rattibhāgena, phullaṃ disvāna kiṃsukaṃ, maṃsapesī'ti maññantā, paribyūḷhā mig'ādhamā.
evaṃ sukhumaṃ kho, bhikkhave, vepacittibandhanaṃ. tato sukhumataraṃ mārabandhanaṃ. maññamāno kho, bhikkhave, baddho mārassa, amaññamāno mutto pāpimato.
anupādiseso'ti maññamāno so evaṃ vadeyya, ambho purisa, ubbhataṃ kho te sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso anupādiseso.

50817.meaning1: outflow of thought; conceptual discharge; stream of conceiving; tide of imagining; (comm) of thought or pride
50817.commentary: (MNa) maññassa vā nappavattantī'ti maññassa vā mānassa vā nappavattanti.

examples.text: chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso chaphass'āyatano aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.
yassu maññāmi samaṇe, pavivittavihārino, sambuddhā iti maññāno, gacchāmi te upāsituṃ.

50819.meaning1: became proud (because of); became conceited (on account of); thought highly of oneself (because of)

examples.text: sādhu kho tvaṃ, samiddhi, puṭṭho puṭṭho vissajjesi, tena ca mā maññī'ti.
evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhikkhave, māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavocaṃ, jānāmi kho t'āhaṃ, pāpima, mā tvaṃ maññittho, na maṃ jānātī'ti. māro tvam'asi, pāpima.

50820.commentary: (THa) asuddhiṃ maññisaṃ suddhin'ti asuddhiṃ maggaṃ suddhiṃ maggan'ti maññisaṃ maññiṃ.

examples.text: so'pi pathaviṃ pathavito abhijānāti, pathaviṃ pathavito abhiññāya pathaviṃ mā maññi, pathaviyā mā maññi, pathavito mā maññi, pathaviṃ me'ti mā maññi, pathaviṃ m'ābhinandi. taṃ kissa hetu? pariññeyyaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.
diṭṭhigahanapakkhando, parāmāsena mohito, asuddhiṃ maññisaṃ suddhiṃ, andhabhūto aviddasu.
maññitaṃ, bhikkhave, rogo, maññitaṃ gaṇḍo, maññitaṃ sallaṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, amaññamānena cetasā viharissāmā'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
asmī'ti, bhikkhave, maññitam'etaṃ, ayam'aham'asmī'ti maññitam'etaṃ, bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ, na bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ, rūpī bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ

50824.meaning1: this is imagination; this is an illusion

examples.text: asmī'ti, bhikkhave, maññitam'etaṃ, ayam'aham'asmī'ti maññitam'etaṃ, bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ, na bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ, rūpī bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ

50825.grammar: aor, reflx 2nd sg of maññi, trans (+acc)
50825.meaning1: you thought; you imagined; you presumed; you supposed

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhikkhave, māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavocaṃ, jānāmi kho t'āhaṃ, pāpima, mā tvaṃ maññittho, na maṃ jānātī'ti. māro tvam'asi, pāpima.
atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavoca, evam'pi kho t'āhaṃ, pāpima, jānāmi, mā tvaṃ maññittho, na maṃ jānātī'ti.

50826.meaning1: having imagined; having presumed; having supposed

50827.grammar: ind, adv, from reflx 1st sg of maññati
50827.meaning1: methinks; one might say; you'd think; as it were

examples.text: tassa evaṃ hoti, mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāma'pi anusāsāma'pi. ime pan'amhākaṃ puttamattā maññe nattamattā maññe ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantī'ti.
atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre mahantaṃ bhayabheravaṃ saddam'akāsi, apissudaṃ pathavī maññe undrīyati

50828.grammar: opt, reflx 3rd sg of maññati, trans (+acc)
50828.meaning1: one should consider oneself (as); one should imagine oneself (to be)

examples.text: vivekaññ'eva sikkhetha, etadariyānam'uttamaṃ, na tena seṭṭho maññetha, sa ve nibbānasantike.
diṭṭhim'pi lokasmiṃ na kappayeyya, ñāṇena vā sīlavatena vā'pi, samo'ti attānam'anūpaneyya, hīno na maññetha visesi vā'pi.

50829.meaning1: would think; could imagine; would presume

examples.text: seyyathā'pi puriso sār'atthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkamm'eva mūlaṃ, atikkamma khandhaṃ, sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya
te mayā pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti, asampāyantā kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaronti. api ca maññ'ev'ettha paṭipucchanti. yannūnn'āhaṃ hīnāy'āvattitvā kāme paribhuñjeyyan'ti.
yathā sākaṭiko maṭṭhaṃ, samaṃ hitvā mahāpathaṃ, visamaṃ maggam'āruyha, akkhacchinno'vajhāyati.
attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attajaṃ attasambhavaṃ, abhimatthati dummedhaṃ, vajiraṃ'v'asmamayaṃ maṇiṃ.
nappaṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā'ti.

50842.commentary: (DNa) maṇi māṇi varo dīgho'ti maṇi ca māṇi ca varo ca dīgho ca.

examples.text: gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo mahantaṃ hatthirājavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami. seyyathā'pi nāma mahāariṭṭhako maṇi, evam'assa sīsaṃ hoti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo. tam'enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvajjeyya, āgaccheyya udakan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

50846.commentary: (VINa) maṇikaṇṭho'ti so kira nāgarājā sabbakāmadadaṃ mah'agghaṃ maṇiṃ kaṇṭhe pilandhitvā carati, tasmā maṇikaṇṭho'tv'eva paññāyittha.

50849.meaning1: jewels and jewellery; gems and rings
50849.commentary: (DHPa) maṇikuṇḍalesū'ti maṇīsu c'eva kuṇḍalesu ca, maṇivicittesu vā kuṇḍalesu.

examples.text: na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujapabbajañ'ca, sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā.
jīno rath'assaṃ maṇikuṇḍale ca, putte ca dāre ca that'eva jīno, sabbesu bhogesu asesitesu, kasmā na santappasi sokakāle.

50850.meaning1: jewels and jewellery; gems and rings

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, puriso yācitakaṃ bhogaṃ yācitvā yānaṃ vā poriseyyaṃ pavara-maṇikuṇḍalaṃ. so tehi yācitakehi bhogehi purakkhato parivuto antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyya.
atha rājā āviñchane bandhaṃ kuñcikamuddikaṃ gaṇhi, maṇikkhandhaṃ passi.

50853.meaning1: like a massive mountain of jewels; (or) like an enormous jewel

examples.text: nadiñ'ca sandantin'ti sandamānañ'ca maṇikkhandhasadisaṃ vimalanīlasītalasalilaṃ nerañjaraṃ nadiṃ addasaṃ.
atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati maṇimālike cetiye maṇibhaddassa yakkhassa bhavane.

50863.meaning1: name of a shrine in Magadha

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati maṇimālike cetiye maṇibhaddassa yakkhassa bhavane.
veṇī nāma suddhakesā vā, suttamissā vā, mālāmissā vā, hiraññamissā vā, suvaṇṇamissā vā, muttāmissā vā, maṇimissā vā.

50866.meaning1: bowl made of crystal or silver, etc.

50867.meaning1: jewel treasure; precious gem; valuable gemstone; one of the seven treasures of a universal ruler

examples.text: tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanam'eva sattamaṃ.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītimaṇisahassāni ahesuṃ maṇiratanappamukhāni.

50868.meaning1: with the precious gem as the foremost (among them)

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītimaṇisahassāni ahesuṃ maṇiratanappamukhāni.

50870.commentary: (DNa) maṇilakkhaṇādīsu evarūpo maṇi pasattho, evarūpo apasattho, sāmino ārogya-issariy'ādīnaṃ hetu hoti, na hotī'ti, evaṃ vaṇṇasaṇṭhān'ādi-vasena maṇi-ādīnaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ anuyuttā viharantī'ti attho.

examples.text: yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, maṇilakkhaṇaṃ vatthalakkhaṇaṃ daṇḍalakkhaṇaṃ satthalakkhaṇaṃ asilakkhaṇaṃ
rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa… caturāsīti maṇisahassāni ahesuṃ maṇiratana-ppamukhāni

50876.meaning1: best part; cream; essence; fine extract

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggam'akkhāyati.
maṇḍapeyyam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, satthā sammukhībhūto.
cakkavattī ahuṃ rājā, jambumaṇḍassa issaro, muddh'āvasitto khattiyo, manuss'ādhipatī ahuṃ.
naccagītavāditavisūkadassanā paṭivirato ahosiṃ. mālā-gandha-vilepana-dhāraṇa-maṇḍana-vibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno

50881.meaning1: who is fond of adornment; who likes beautifying oneself

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭiyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya.

50882.meaning1: who is fond of adornment; who likes beautifying oneself

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā, daharo yuvā maṇḍanajātiko, ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte, acche vā udakapatte, sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno, sace tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā, tass'eva rajassa vā aṅgaṇassa vā pahānāya vāyamati.

50883.meaning1: practice of beautifying and adorning oneself
50883.meaning2: practice of beautifying and adorning oneself

examples.text: te evarūpaṃ maṇḍana-vibhūsanaṭṭhān'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyath'idaṃ, ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ ādāsaṃ añjanaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ mukhacuṇṇaṃ mukhalepanaṃ hatthabandhaṃ sikhābandhaṃ daṇḍaṃ

50884.meaning1: for embellishment; for bulk; for shape
50884.commentary: (VISM) na maṇḍanāyā'ti na antepurikavesiy'ādayo viya maṇḍanatthaṃ, aṅgapaccaṅgānaṃ pīṇabhāvanimittan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
āvasathapiṇḍo nāma pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ sālāya vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā ajjhokāse vā anodissa yāva'd'attho paññatto hoti.

50886.meaning2: of the best quality; lit. to be drunk like cream
50886.commentary: (SNa) maṇḍapeyyan'ti pasannaṭṭhena maṇḍaṃ, pātabbaṭṭhena peyyaṃ. yañ'hi pivitvā antaravīthiyaṃ patito visaññī attano sāṭak'ādīnam'pi assāmiko hoti, taṃ pasannam'pi na pātabbaṃ, mayhaṃ pana sāsanaṃ evaṃ pasannañ'ca pātabbañcāti dassento maṇḍapeyyan'ti āha.

examples.text: maṇḍapeyyam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, satthā sammukhībhūto.
anekasākhañ'ca sahassamaṇḍalaṃ, chattaṃ marū dhārayum'antalikkhe, suvaṇṇadaṇḍā vītipatanti cāmarā, na dissare cāmarachattagāhakā.
parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsetabbaṃ nābhimaṇḍalaṃ jāṇumaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādentena. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca purato vā pacchato vā olambento nivāseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
chattaṃ nāma tīṇi chattāni, setacchattaṃ, kilañjacchattaṃ, paṇṇacchattaṃ maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.
adaṇḍena asatthena, vijeyya pathaviṃ imaṃ, asāhasena kammena, samena anusāsi taṃ, dhammena rajjaṃ kāretvā, asmiṃ pathavimaṇḍale.

50896.meaning1: (of a sunshade) bound to the circular rim
50896.commentary: (VINa) maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhan'ti idaṃ pana tiṇṇam'pi chattānaṃ pañjaradassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ. tāni hi maṇḍalabaddhāni c'eva honti salākabaddhāni ca.

examples.text: chattaṃ nāma tīṇi chattāni, setacchattaṃ, kilañjacchattaṃ, paṇṇacchattaṃ maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.
keṇiyo pana jaṭilo sāmaṃ'y'eva maṇḍalamālaṃ paṭiyādeti.

50898.commentary: (DNa) maṇḍalamāḷe'ti katthaci dve kaṇṇikā gahetvā haṃsavaṭṭakacchannena katā kūṭ'āgārasālā'pi maṇḍalamāḷo'ti vuccati, katthaci ekaṃ kaṇṇikaṃ gahetvā thambhapantiṃ parikkhipitvā katā upaṭṭhānasālā'pi maṇḍalamāḷo'ti vuccati. idha pana nisīdanasālā maṇḍalamāḷo'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.

atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ karerimaṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi, iti'pi pubbenivāso, iti'pi pubbenivāso'ti.

50899.meaning2: name of a monastery in Sri Lanka
